enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Good Luck +1: This item gives a +1 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Underwater Action: This item grants the wearer the ability to breathe water as if it were air.
Protection +3: Passive: +3 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
